channel.title: Dragons' Den
channel.desc: A brave new batch of business hopefuls step into the Dragons' lair. Guest Dragon and beauty powerhouse Jenna Meek brings her business brilliance to the Den alongside Peter Jones, Deborah Meaden, Touker Suleyman and Steven Bartlett. In this episode, a maths teacher turned founder tees things off with a miniature golf game you play with your fingers. A Dorset-based duo hope their premium canned seafood can hook the Dragons.
